id: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)

dish.n: Mr Tumnus's brown eggs and soldiers
dish.note: Soft-boiled brown eggs with hot buttered toast soldiers, laid out for tea in the faun's cave.
dish.how: Lower the eggs into simmering water and cook for 6 minutes. Toast the bread, butter it while hot and cut into fingers. Sit the eggs in cups, take off the tops and serve with the soldiers and a little salt.
dish.make_ahead: Best made to order; set the cups and butter out ahead

steps.text: Lower the eggs into simmering water and cook for 6 minutes.
Toast the bread, butter it hot and cut into fingers.
Serve the eggs in cups with the soldiers.
